name: Component-required cutout present
description: A footprint that needs a milled opening (mid-mount connector, SD-card holder, buzzer) declares it on Edge.Cuts inside the footprint. This verifies the board outline actually has a matching cutout there. One-directional: a board cutout that no component declared is not a finding. Requires design data carrying footprint graphics; not evaluable from bare Gerbers.
what_it_measures: Count of footprint-declared cutouts with no matching opening in the board outline (0 when every declared cutout was milled).
